# Timing Chain Tensioner Rattle on Cold Start

**Make**: Audi
**Model**: A4
**Year**: 2013
**Diagnostic Code**: P0016

## Description and Procedure
Metallic rattle from front timing cover lasting 2-3 seconds after cold start points to leaking hydraulic timing chain tensioner.
Vehicle system troubleshooting guidance for P0016 on 2013 Audi A4.
Always adhere to shop safety practices when servicing engine systems.
